name: Service Week Overrides
description: Admin controls for blocking faculty from specific weeks or manually assigning them to services
author: FacultyHub Team
features: Block specific faculty from specific weeks (e.g., remote faculty who can't do certain services)
Manually assign faculty to specific service/week combinations
View all active blocks and manual assignments
Prevents scheduler from assigning blocked faculty
use_cases: Block remote faculty from in-person services
Reserve specific weeks for specific faculty (e.g., research weeks)
Handle special circumstances not captured by the optimizer
integration_notes: Blocks are checked before schedule generation
Manual assignments take precedence over automated assignments
Overrides are preserved when re-running the scheduler
